scenario: independent closed-loop vertical tracking, one drone, 8 s, 50 Hz controller, 500 Hz plant
control: same frozen altitude position and velocity feedback; each plant uses its own observation
mujoco_physics: mj_step free rigid body, gravity, external vertical thrust and linear drag; Python motor ODE
limits: Only 1-D vertical, zero attitude, no contact/disturbance, shared coefficients; not Sim2Real or trained neural policy transfer.
